products.name: Raffles Shield
products.subtype: MediSave-approved Integrated Shield Plan with 4 base plans: Standard, B, A, Private (options: Raffles Hospital Option, High Deductible Option)
products.summary: Integrated Shield Plan that complements MediShield Life, paid by MediSave, with four basic plans from B1 ward in restructured hospitals to private hospitals.
facts: Four basic plans: Raffles Shield Standard, B, A and Private
Policy Year Limit is $300,000 for Plan B and $600,000 for Plan A
Minimum entry age is 1 year and last entry age is 75 years (age next birthday); the last entry age limit does not apply to Raffles Shield Standard
High Deductible Option: opt for a $10,000 deductible to enjoy lower premiums
Foreigners are only eligible for Raffles Shield Private

products.name: Raffles Choice Rider
products.subtype: co-payment rider for Raffles Shield B, A, Private (replaces Raffles Key Rider from 1 April 2026)
products.summary: Rider that replaces the 10% co-insurance with a lower 5% co-payment, capped per policy year, and adds cover for some cancer drugs not on the Cancer Drug List.
facts: Replaces the 10% co-insurance (after deductible) with a lower 5% co-payment
Co-payment capped at $6,000 per policy year when treated by RHI Panel / Extended Panel specialists or GRH
Covers cancer drug treatments not on the Cancer Drug List, with benefits of up to $5,000
Applicable for Raffles Shield B, A, Private Plans (without High Deductibles)

products.name: Raffles Critical Illness Plan
products.subtype: yearly or 5-year renewable term CI plan, simple health declaration (3 questions)
products.summary: Critical illness plan paying a lump sum on diagnosis of 37 major stage critical illnesses, with a choice of yearly or 5-year renewable term.
facts: Covers 37 critical illnesses with 100% lump sum payout

Minimum entry age is 19 years old, and last entry age is 60 (age next birthday)
3 simple health declaration questions; no medical examination at application
Eligible: Singapore Citizen, Permanent Resident or foreigner with a valid pass and FIN

products.name: Raffles Elite Care
products.subtype: non-MediSave regional hospital and surgical plan (Gold / Silver / Bronze), not an Integrated Shield Plan
products.summary: Comprehensive hospital and surgical medical plan for living or working in Singapore, ASEAN, China (excl. Hong Kong), India and South Korea, with an optional outpatient rider.

Outpatient Rider adds up to S$2,000 annual medical coverage within the Raffles Medical Group network in Singapore

notes: Individual product menu (Singapore, Regional and Global coverage) lists only Raffles Shield, Raffles Critical Illness Plan, Raffles Elite Care, Lifeline and Worldwide Health Options; the other categories were checked against that menu and the sitemap page.
Raffles Key Rider is not listed: sales ceased from 1 April 2026 and it is replaced by Raffles Choice Rider (site FAQ dated 2026).
Raffles Hospital Option and High Deductible Option are options on Raffles Shield, not riders, and are described in the Raffles Shield entry.

Raffles Choice Rider and Raffles Premier Rider have no standalone web page; they are described on the Raffles Shield Plans page and have their own policy conditions PDFs. Raffles Cancer Guard Rider has its own page.

Raffles Elite Care is a non-MediSave regional hospital and surgical plan, tagged hospitalisation as the nearest category; Lifeline and Worldwide Health Options are international plans insured by RHI and administered by Bupa Global.
Lifeline is also served at /products/personal/global-medical-cover/lifeline/ and /lifeline/; the lifeline-3 page is used.
The Raffles Critical Illness product summary PDF is image-only (no extractable text), so its figures are not used; facts come from the product page.
Business products (Raffles Corporate Care, Customised Group Insurance, Foreign Workers Medical Insurance, Oil and Gas, Maritime, TPA) were skipped as group/corporate.
The Raffles Elite Care brochure and product summary sit under upload paths dated 2021 and 2025 but carry 15 May 2025 version stamps.
No page was bot-blocked; all product URLs returned HTTP 200 to scripted requests.
